view: Fundamentals are strong and the stock is cheap against its own growth (17.85x forward EPS with 83.4% TTM revenue growth), but last quarter's FCF fell by more than half while total debt tripled, and the 2026-11-17 print is a binary event inside every window. Before the print I lean mildly bullish on the quarters and roughly balanced but wide on 2 weeks. Strategic: Accumulate (in stages, owner's ladder only). Tactical: Wait until the print.

probabilities.defs: 2w ±5%, quarters ±10%, vs price_at_call 165.785. next_2_weeks: up = close > 174.07, down = close < 157.50, range in between, measured at the 2026-11-26 close. this_quarter: to the last close of 2026-12-31; next_quarter: to the last close of 2027-03-31; up > 182.36, down < 149.21, range in between. up + range + down = 100.

evidence.point: Outside view: 33 up / 45 range / 22 down (n=258). I moved range down 11 and both tails up (+3 up, +8 down) because the 2026-11-17 print sits inside the window and daily ATR is already 5.9% (structure.atr_daily_pct), which makes a ±5% move more likely than in an average 2-week window.
Outside view 39/43/18 (n=253). Moved to 41/34/25: earnings widens both tails; down raised more than up because of the cash-flow and debt flags below.
Outside view 50/31/19 (n=247), but the window to 2027-03-31 is about 20 weeks, longer than the 13w sample, so range should be smaller. Moved to 52/26/22.
After 2-week drops of 15% or more, 13w outcomes were 100% up (median +32.1%), but n=4 with overlapping windows. Weak evidence; it nudges up only by a point or two.
TTM revenue 302.97B, +83.4% YoY; last quarter 96.22B, +105.9% YoY. Growth is accelerating on a quarterly basis, not fading.

The bar for 2026-11-17: consensus revenue 108.67B (about +12.9% vs last quarter's 96.22B) and EPS 2.47. These are the numbers a beat or miss is measured against; guidance for the following quarter is not in slice.
Gross margin 74.7%, operating margin 65.2%, net margin 63.7%. Very high margins leave little room for upside surprise and make any margin slip on the print a material negative.

P/E TTM 20.94 and forward P/E 17.85 on next-FY EPS 9.29 (TTM EPS 7.9482, implying about +17% EPS growth). Price-to-sales TTM 13.28. Against 83.4% revenue growth this is a low multiple; the market is pricing a sharp growth slowdown or margin peak.

Last-quarter FCF 21.40B vs 48.59B the prior quarter (down about 56%) while revenue grew. Cause (working capital, inventory, prepayments, capex) is not in slice. This is the main quality-of-earnings question for the print.

Total debt rose from 12.81B to 38.86B in one quarter (about 3x, +26.05B). Debt/equity is still only 0.17 and TTM FCF is 127.0B, so solvency is not a concern, but the purpose of the new debt is not in slice and should be explained on the call.

Analyst group (count once): 63 of 73 buy/overweight, 9 hold, 1 sell; targets avg 309.21, low 180, high 710.29. The lowest target is above price. Dispersion is extreme (low-to-high ratio about 3.9x), so the average is a weak anchor; treat as one sentiment input, not as a valuation.

Earnings 2026-11-17 21:00 UTC, after close, confirmed. Quarter end 2026-10-31. Fiscal-label convention as served by TradingView (Q3 2025..Q3 2026), so quarter labels may not match Nvidia's own fiscal naming.
Same day as the print: October retail sales (2026-11-17). Monthly options expiry 2026-11-20 and core PCE/GDP 2026-11-25 fall inside the 2-week window and can amplify the post-earnings move.

Price is 31.9% below the 243.37 ATH and -11.2% on the week while fundamentals in slice show no deterioration in revenue or margins. The drawdown is a multiple compression, not an earnings collapse (so far).

Options positioning / implied earnings move is not in my slice and not available this run, so I cannot say how big a move is priced. Guidance, segment mix, hyperscaler capex and export news are also not in slice. This caps my confidence at 45.

key_levels.why: Lowest analyst price target; a sustained close above it would mean the stock is back inside the full analyst range.
Bottom of the gap zone 179.92-185.22; a strong print could fill it within the 2-week window.
2-week down bucket edge (-5%); a miss or weak guide with ATR at 9.86 could reach it in one session.
Quarter down bucket edge (-10%); about 16x forward EPS of 9.29, roughly where valuation support becomes very strong unless estimates are cut.

what_would_change_my_mind: 2026-11-17 print: revenue below 108.67B or EPS below 2.47, or gross margin falling meaningfully below 74.7%, would move me to Hold strategic / Avoid New Entry tactical and shift about 10 points from up to down on both quarters.

2026-11-17 print: a clear beat with an explanation that the FCF drop (21.40B vs 48.59B) was temporary working capital and the debt rise to 38.86B was planned, would move up about 8 points on both quarters and tactical to Accumulate.
If next-FY EPS estimate (9.29) is cut after the print, the 17.85x forward P/E is not as cheap as it looks; I would drop the quarter up buckets.
Any thesis break (TB1-TB4) firing pauses buying regardless of the print.
A close below 149.21 before 2026-12-31 without an estimate cut would make me check for a non-fundamental driver (macro or export news) before changing the strategic view.
notes_for_chair: Pre-print view: wide and mildly bullish on quarters (valuation cheap vs growth, drawdown is multiple compression). Post-print view will be driven by guidance and the FCF/debt explanation, not the headline beat; re-score after 2026-11-17.
The FCF halving and debt tripling in one quarter are the two numbers the red team should press on; I do not know their cause from my slice.
Implied earnings move (options) is missing; the technical member's ATR (9.86, 5.9%) is the only proxy I have. Do not treat missing options data as neutral.
Hyperscaler capex (TB4) and export-control news (TB1/TB3) are outside my slice; narrative and macro members should confirm none has fired.
Analyst targets/ratings count as one evidence group; do not double count them with narrative or sentiment members citing the same targets.
Stance: strategic Accumulate in stages per owner's ladder (owner approval required for any ladder change); tactical Wait until after the 2026-11-17 print. No orders placed or suggested.
